$comment: ADR-113 Amendment 4 fixture. JSON-RPC 2.0 POSTed to the daemon's OAuth listener with a bearer token, exactly as kb/query.* is. Clients branch on error.data.kind only; error.code is informative. Identifiers, hashes and times are examples; times are RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds. Field names and kinds are normative.
description: Puts every member of a fully approved request into force in one transaction; each node's previous in-force revision becomes `superseded`. `effective_at` may not be later than the act (plus clock skew) in this amendment; scheduled entry into force is open (O20).

headers.Authorization: Bearer <the person's IdP access token for this daemon's audience>

error.message: every member must be approved first
